stage: Second development-only observation-label batch; first-pass manual labels remain provisional, not independent physical gold.
source: data/ACN_real_user_benchmark_v1_20261102; original roles and all raw values unchanged
selection: 64 additional native windows: training 12 and validation 4 per four received-limit strata. Deterministic user-balanced hashes, prioritize users not in the first batch. Exclude windows overlapping earlier selected windows in the same source session. Select using received-limit history and timestamps only, not power response or algorithm results.
target: The same separate whole-window observed-change and anchor-following labels as the first batch, with explicitly unresolved cases. Record native timing brackets only where actually discernible. No causal success, noise-free power, sensor fault or effective-duration targets inferred from command duration.
source_audit: Read original voltage, charging-state and cumulative-energy fields as context, in addition to current, received limit and power. A missing voltage or zero limit with positive output is a source/semantic flag, not a fault truth. Same-EVSE channels are not independent instruments.
review: Single-assistant visual raw-data review, no CPOP/LABS/model outputs, not an independent second reviewer. Keep old first-pass labels and receipts immutable; export a new unlabelled task packet.
scope: No production training, algorithm adoption, reference prediction, report or second-block work. Closed test and external-test values remain unread.
coverage: Sampling strata are not class labels or natural population rates; retain all selected cases and unresolved observations. Preserve role/user/session lineage in any future expansion or windowing.
outcome: Increase reviewed development coverage and audit existing source assumptions before a fixed real-data training comparison. This batch does not produce a new real accuracy.
